app.name: Doodle Shooter
app.short_description: A hand-drawn notebook-doodle space shooter (Classic Controller)
app.long_description:
Fly your crayon rocket across the Notebook Nebula with four weapons, turn on a dime to fight in both directions, and take down the grumpy Hexacore.
Controls (Classic Controller): Left stick / D-Pad: fly A: Pulse Blaster (hold; watch the heat) B: Circle Shield (hold; spinning sabres, cut bullets) X: Swarm Missiles (homing, lock on to most baddies on screen) Y: Power Lazer (screen-wide beam) L / R: turn around ZL / ZR: boost (2 charges) +: pause -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
